basic_info.description: Discover charm, scale, and period details at this SFH located in the Forest Hill Extension neighborhood. With original details, like glass French doors and stunning hardwood floors, the living room is the width of the home with arched windows, original molding, trim, and a gas fireplace. The eat-in kitchen was designed for entertaining, equipped with a hutch like wall of cabinets offering ample storage, stainless steel appliances, Bosch dishwasher, Bertazzoni gas stove, range hood, and built-in JennAire refrigerator. Off the kitchen is a half bath, and an additional spacious room that can be used as an office or potential third BR.  Upstairs, there are two bedrooms, one featuring a walk-in closet with custom closet organizers, an updated full bath with built-in storage for linens, and a laundry closet.  The large backyard features mature landscaping and multiple flat patio areas perfect for entertaining.  Additional features include a 1 car garage with ample storage, driveway for additional car, a large partial basement (over 600ft per rendering)- with great ceiling height. This offers potential for further expansion, as many of the homes on this side of the street have already done. Spacious as is, or a great opportunity for those looking to expand for their forever home.
